tei:div.tei:p: mngon rtogs rgyan gyi sa bcad snang byed sgron me gzhung dang bcas pa/ skabs dang po/ rnam mkhyen/ 1 skabs gnyis pa/ lam shes/ 25 skabs gsum pa/ gzhi shes/ 35 skabs bzhi pa/ rnam rdzogs sbyor ba/ 41 skabs lnga pa/ rtse mo'i sbyor ba/ 59 skabs drug pa/ mthar gyis sbyor ba/ 72 skabs bdun pa/ skad cig ma'i sbyor ba/ 73 skabs brgyad pa/ 'bras bu chos sku/ 75 sher phyin skabs brgyad kyi stong thun/ 89 gzhi shes/ 90 lam shes/ 94 rnam mkhyen/ 96 yul mkhyen gsum gyi sgra don/ 101 yul mkhyen gsum gyi dbye ba/ 102 mkhyen gsum bye brag tu ngos 'dzin pa/ 103 thabs sbyor ba bzhi/ 107 chos sku ngos bzung ba/ 114 dngos po brgyad kyi sa mtshams/ 115 rnam mkhyen gyi chos bcu/ 119 lam shes kyi chos bcu gcig 122 gzhi shes kyi chos dgu 127 rnam rdzogs sbyor ba'i chos bcu gnyis/ 130 rtse mo'i chos bdun/ 134 mthar gyis pa'i chos bcu gsum/ 138 skad cig ma'i chos bzhi/ 142 chos sku'i mtshan nyid/ 144 chos dbyings bstod pa'i rtsa ba/ 147 dbu ma chos dbyings bstod pa'i rnam par bshad pa/ 157 gnas skabs gsum du chos kyi dbyings ji ltar gnas pa ston pa las/ sems can gyi gnas skabs na ji ltar gnas tshul la gnyis te/ 1 ngo bo mdor bstan pa*/ 160 2 dpe dang sbyar te rgyas par bshad pa'o/ 176 gnyis pa rgyas bshad dpe dang sbyar te bstan pa la bdun te/ 1 mar gyi dpes chos kyi dbyings mi snang ba dang snang ba'i tshul/ 176 2 bum nang gi mar me'i dpes sems can dang*/ lam dang*/ sangs rgyas la ye shes snang ba'i rim pa bstan pa/ 177 3 skye 'gag dang bral zhing mi 'gyur ba'i don/ 180 4 sems can dang sangs rgyas kyi gnas skabs su khyad par med par nor bu'i dpes bshad pa/ 182 5 khams de'i ngo bo gser gyi dpes bshad pa/ 184 6 'bras shun gyi dpes chos kyi sku snang ba'i tshul/ 184 7 chu shing gi dpes rgyu mthun pa rab tu zab pa'i chos/ 186

234 4 bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i 'phrin las/ 240 5 byang chub nye ring med pa'i don bshad pa'o// 243 gsum pa lam thob tshul la lnga ste/ 1 blang dor gyi tshul shes par bya ba/ 245 2 'khor ba'i gnyen po/ 246 3 zhi ba'i gnyen po/ 248 4 khams rgyas par bya ba'i chos/ 251 5 tshul ji ltar rgyas pa'i rim pa'o// 261 bzhi pa khams rgyas par bya ba bstan pa la gsum ste/ 1 khams rgyas byed kyi chos ngos bzung ba/ 251 2 de las byang chub 'grub pa/ 255 3 rgyal bas bsrung bar 'gyur ba'o// 261 lnga pa tshul ji ltar rgyas pa'i rim pa la bzhi ste/ 1 mos pas spyod pas mthong tshul/ 261 2 sa la zhugs pa khong du rgyas pa'i dpe/ 262 3 mthar thug par dpe mdor bstan/ 263 4 rgyas bshad do// 264 bzhi pa rgyas par bshad pa la bcu gcig ste/ 1 mos pas spyod pa'i sa/ 264 2 rab tu dga' ba/ 264 3 dri ma med pa/ 266 4 'od byed pa/ 267 5 'od 'phro ba/ 268 6 sbyang dka' ba/ 270 7 mngon du gyur pa/ 271 8 ring du song ba/ 272 9 mi g.yo ba/ 273 10 legs pa'i blo gros/ 275 11 chos kyi sprin bshad pa'o// 276 bzhi pa dri ma thams cad dang bral ba'i chos sku la bstod pa la bzhi ste/ 1 gnas gyur pa'i chos sku rang gi ngo bo/ 280 2 bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ 284 3 rtogs pa'i yon tan/ 286 4 'phrin las bshad pa'o// 297 gsum pa rtogs pa mthar thug pa'i yon tan bshad pa la bzhi ste/ 1 sems dag pa'i tshul/ 286 2 ye shes kyi lus rdzogs pa/ 287 3 dag pa'i yon tan/ 288 4 thob pa'i yon tan no// 291 bzhi pa 'phrin las bshad pa la lnga ste/ 1 'phrin las kyi gtso bo rgyal sras dbang bskur bstsol ba/ 297 2 'khor ba na 'phrin las mdzad tshul/ 299 3 zhi ba rnams bskul ba/ 300 4 mya ngan las 'das pa'i don/ 302 5 'bad pa med pa'i 'phrin las kyi don bstan pa'o// 303
